params.name: LOOP
params.desc: see chapter 4.9.

params.name: LLaser
params.desc: if false, all laser fields are turned off.

params.name: L_Type()
params.desc: type of laser beam. Valid keywords are: CW = cw Gaussian laser beam GLB = short pulse Gaussian Laser Beam RPL = short pulse Radially Polarized Laser beam

params.name: L_Z1()
params.desc: start position of the interaction region with the laser field.

params.name: L_Z2()
params.desc: end position of the interaction region with the laser field.

params.name: L_H()
params.desc: local time step setting, active if ≠ 0.0.

params.name: L_F()
params.desc: longitudinal position of the focus.

params.name: L_zstart()
params.desc: longitudinal start position of the laser beam.

params.name: L_tstart()
params.desc: start time of the laser beam.

params.name: L_xoff()
params.desc: transverse offset of the laser field in x.

params.name: L_yoff()
params.desc: transverse offset of the laser field in y.

params.name: L_xrot()
params.desc: rotation angle of the laser field in the x-z plane, i.e. around the y-axis.

params.name: L_yrot()
params.desc: rotation angle of the laser field in the y-z plane, i.e. around the x-axis.

params.name: L_zrot()
params.desc: rotation angle of the laser field around the z-axis, i.e. in the x-y plane.

params.name: L_E0()
params.desc: pulse energy of the laser.

params.name: L_Pow()
params.desc: pulse power of the laser.

params.name: L_a0()
params.desc: normalized vector potential of the laser in the focus.

params.name: L_Epeak()
params.desc: electric field amplitude of the laser in the focus.

params.name: L_tau()
params.desc: temporal 1/e pulse width of the laser field.

params.name: L_phi()
params.desc: carrier envelope phase.

params.name: L_lam()
params.desc: wave length of the laser radiation.

params.name: L_sig0()
params.desc: transverse rms size of the laser intensity at the focus position (σ_x = σ_y = σ).

params.name: L_w0()
params.desc: transverse size of the laser intensity at the focus position = 2·L_sig0(). If L_sig0() and L_w0() are specified L_sig0() has priority,

params.name: L_delta()
params.desc: polarization factor; Abs(L_delta()) ≤1L_delta() = ±1.0 linear polarization in x directionL_delta() = 0.0 linear polarization in y directionL_delta() = 1/2 circularly polarized laser beam.

params.name: L_window()
params.desc: defines a window type for cw Gaussian laser beam. The window is applied over the interaction range. Valid types are:Blackman: a standard Blackman windowTukey: a Tukey window with taper parameter L_alpha()

params.name: L_alpha()
params.desc: Taper parameter for Tukey window; 0 < L_alpha() ≤ 1.
